description: NaCaBeSi₂O₆F crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.94 Å. There is one shorter (2.40 Å) and one longer (2.76 Å) Na-F bond length. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-3.01 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.48 Å. Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form BeO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.64 Å. The Be-F bond length is 1.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BeO₃F tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BeO₃F tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.61 Å) and two longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ca, one Be, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one Si atom. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Be atom.
